text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer Training Camp with Gold City has 
begun. Cutting off all outside contact, 
she demonstrates her complete seriousness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to train me for real for the 
Kikuka Sho." Her heart seemed to burn with 
determination.
